info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Agents-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings API enables users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of real estate listings associated with specific agents. This endpoint is designed for real estate platforms, agents, and consumers looking to explore available properties through personalized queries. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experiences by integrating real estate data seamlessly into applications, helping users find properties more efficiently. Typical use cases include property search functionalities on real estate websites or mobile applications.

get.summary: Retrieve all listings managed by a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a comprehensive list of property listings that are associated with a particular real estate agent. The listings include various attributes and details relevant to the properties managed by the agent.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving listings associated with a specific agent. This request expects parameters defined in the schema to fetch and filter agent listings effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully; returns a list of agent listings.
